images.author: CDC / Charles D. Humphrey
images.why: PHIL 10708: caption confirms a digitally colourised TEM of clustered norovirus virions. Purple particles against orange provide strong contrast for a near-square crop. Verified URL is the preview JPEG; the page lists a 7.03 MB original, but its direct URL and pixel dimensions could not be verified. CDC requests attribution.
